wiki_item: B8 Footstep SFX + day/night ambient variation
audiobank_new_methods: SwapAmbientToNight() -- idempotent clip swap on ambientSource to sfxAmbientNight
SwapAmbientToDay() -- idempotent clip swap on ambientSource back to sfxAmbient

throttle_decisions.PlayFootstep_bank_side: 0.20s (FootstepInterval) -- defense-in-depth; multiple walking pawns would combine at 60fps without this
throttle_decisions.FootstepDriver_per_pawn: 0.40s (FootstepInterval in FootstepDriver) -- primary per-pawn gate; yields ~2.5 steps/sec natural cadence
throttle_decisions.SwapAmbient_no_throttle: State-machine driven; _isNightAmbient idempotency flag in AudioBank prevents re-trigger; _wasNight flag in FootstepDriver detects transitions only

footstep.wav.character: low earth-thud (75Hz body) + grit noise burst, exponential decay, 8ms click-safe fade

ambient_night.wav.character: cricket chirp texture (2.2Hz + 1.8Hz chirp LFO, 3500Hz band noise + 1800/4200Hz resonance), 40Hz sub-air, 0.8s loop-safe fade

flags_for_qa: AudioBank scene-wiring: assign footstep.wav to AudioBank.sfxFootstep in Inspector
AudioBank scene-wiring: assign ambient_night.wav to AudioBank.sfxAmbientNight in Inspector
FootstepDriver self-bootstraps ([RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)], hidden GO, FindFirstObjectByType guard)
Ambient swap tested at DayProgress~0.083 (02:00) -> night crickets; DayProgress=0.50 (12:00) -> day birds
No Unity run needed -- QA verifies via build + inspector wiring

wiki_b8_acceptance.footstep: A walking pawn plays a faint footstep ~every 0.4s -- FootstepDriver per-pawn 0.4s throttle + AudioBank.PlayFootstep() vol=0.45
wiki_b8_acceptance.ambient: Ambient bed differs at 02:00 vs 12:00 -- SwapAmbientToNight (crickets) on DayProgress<0.27 or >=0.83; SwapAmbientToDay (birds) on [0.27,0.83)

lane_isolation_proof: FootstepDriver.cs (NEW file only) + AudioBank.cs (edited -- single AudioBank lane this wave). No other files edited. PawnMovement and DayNightCycle read-only. No SceneSetup, ClickSelector, BuildManager, FloatingText, MarqueeSelector, or test files touched.
